title: Synthetic Workstation Manifest
description: Spec for a daily-loop manifest. Defines the base disk to plant on, the categories of threats to plant, and the per-artifact expected pipeline behavior. The build script reads this and produces a planted raw NTFS image; the score script reads pipeline output and compares against this manifest to produce a per-artifact pass/fail report.

intel_window_days.description: How many days back the research agent searched.

intel_sources.description: URLs the research agent cited when constructing this manifest.

base.description: The known-positive disk that planted artifacts overlay onto. The base's known findings must be re-detected by the pipeline; if they regress, the build is invalid.

windows_partition_index.description: Which partition on the raw disk holds the Windows install. Defaults to 1 (first NTFS partition).

expected_baseline_findings.description: Findings already known on the base disk (regression assertion target). Pipeline must re-find every one.

categories.description: Threat categories to plant on top of the base disk. Each category groups artifacts thematically.

expected_detection.description: What the pipeline should classify this as.

expected_quarantine.description: True if the injection scanner should fire on this artifact.

rationale.description: Why this artifact is in the manifest (which scanner / classifier behavior it tests).

source_url.description: Threat-intel source that motivated planting this artifact.

key_path.description: Registry key path within the hive. Required for registry_* types. Use single backslash.

value_data.description: Plain string value. For registry_run_key, the command line.

task_xml.description: Required for scheduled_task_xml. Full Task XML body.

task_install_path.description: Path within Windows\System32\Tasks\ where the task XML is dropped.

file_path.description: Required for file_drop and file_drop_sqlite_chrome_history. Absolute path under the planted Windows root, e.g. 'Users/analyst/AppData/Roaming/.huggingface/token'.

chrome_history_entries.description: For file_drop_sqlite_chrome_history. Each entry becomes a row in the urls table.

last_visit_offset_seconds.description: Seconds before manifest_id at midnight UTC (negative = earlier).
